runs.name: A1-work-only
runs.task: Art pass: improve the visual quality of classic-snake. The snake head, body segments, food apple, and background tile all use basic SVG placeholder art. Replace or improve them with more polished visuals that match a clean retro-arcade aesthetic: the snake should have a distinct head shape and segmented body, the food should look like a bright apple or berry, and the background tile should be a subtle dark grid. Keep all assets as SVGs committed to assets/sprites/. Do not change any game logic.
